league_game_side_ban.name: league_game_side_ban
league_game_side_ban.value: ("league_game_side"."ban" IS NULL) = ("league_game_side"."banned_at" IS NULL) AND ("league_game_side"."ban" IS NULL OR "league_game_side"."ban" BETWEEN 0 AND 7)

league_match_home.name: league_match_home
league_match_home.value: ("league_match"."round_id" IS NULL) <> ("league_match"."cup_id" IS NULL) AND ("league_match"."cup_id" IS NULL) = ("league_match"."slot" IS NULL)

league_match_score.name: league_match_score
league_match_score.value: ("league_match"."games_a" IS NULL) = ("league_match"."games_b" IS NULL) AND ("league_match"."games_a" IS NULL OR ("league_match"."games_a" BETWEEN 0 AND 2 AND "league_match"."games_b" BETWEEN 0 AND 2 AND "league_match"."games_a" <> "league_match"."games_b" AND GREATEST("league_match"."games_a", "league_match"."games_b") = 2))

league_match_fainted.name: league_match_fainted
league_match_fainted.value: ("league_match"."fainted_a" IS NULL OR "league_match"."fainted_a" >= 0) AND ("league_match"."fainted_b" IS NULL OR "league_match"."fainted_b" >= 0)

save_progress_source.name: save_progress_source
save_progress_source.value: "save"."progress_id" IS NULL OR ("save"."progress_set_by" IS NOT NULL AND "save"."progress_set_at" IS NOT NULL)

save_hatched_source.name: save_hatched_source
save_hatched_source.value: ("save"."hatched_set" IS NULL AND NOT "save"."hatched_imported") OR ("save"."hatched_set" IS NOT NULL AND "save"."hatched_set_at" IS NOT NULL AND ("save"."hatched_set_by" IS NULL) = "save"."hatched_imported")

snapshot_fainted_source.name: snapshot_fainted_source
snapshot_fainted_source.value: "snapshot"."fainted_set" IS NULL OR ("snapshot"."fainted_set_by" IS NOT NULL AND "snapshot"."fainted_set_at" IS NOT NULL)

team_locked_by.name: team_locked_by
team_locked_by.value: "team"."locked_by" IS NULL OR "team"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL
